This afternoon, Mr. and Mrs. Ahmed are working in the garden. The weather is lovely. Mrs. Ahmed is sitting on a tree stump while Mr. Ahmed is cleaning the weeds from the tomato beds nearby. Mrs. Ahmed looks happy. Mr. Ahmed is spending a lot of time with her helping in the garden these days. They are talking about their daughters Maya and Sneha who are coming home for a week’s vacation from Dhaka tomorrow. The train arrives at 8 in the morning. Mrs. Ahmed is telling her husband not to tell the girls anything about her garden. She wonders how surprised and happy they will be when they see her gorgeous tomatoes and the lettuce!
